parts.text: Remove the extra third hand at her collar that is holding the green IV bag. She must have only two hands: the two raised clawed hands with long bloody blade nails on each side stay exactly as they are. The green glowing IV bag now hangs on its own from a small hook clipped to her shirt pocket strap, with its tube running down to her wrist as before. Fill the area where the extra hand was with her plaid flannel shirt and collar. Keep everything else identical: bandage wrap, face, grey bun, axe on her back, exposed ribs, tool belt, rust clay backdrop, clay style. No text.
